async def run_edge(self, session_id: str = "default") -> None:
    """
    Runs the full always-listening voice loop on edge hardware
    (Raspberry Pi, Mac, Windows, Linux laptop).
    """
    if websockets is None:
        raise RuntimeError("websockets is required. Install with: pip install websockets")

    # 1. Resolve Audio Hardware Devices
    in_dev = AudioDeviceManager.find_device_index(self.config.input_device, is_input=True)
    out_dev = AudioDeviceManager.find_device_index(self.config.output_device, is_input=False)

    print("\n" + "=" * 60)
    print("🎙️  [VOICE AGENT INITIALIZED]")
    print("=" * 60)
    print(f"  Model            : {self.config.model}")
    print(f"  Voice            : {self.config.voice}")
    print(f"  Mic Device       : {'Default' if in_dev is None else f'Index {in_dev}'}")
    print(f"  Speaker Device   : {'Default' if out_dev is None else f'Index {out_dev}'}")
    print(f"  Interrupt Thresh : {self.config.interrupt_rms_threshold}")
    print(f"  Noise Gate Thresh: {self.config.noise_gate_threshold}")
    print("=" * 60 + "\n")

    # 2. Audio Pipeline Setup
    vad_config = VADConfig(
        interrupt_rms_threshold=self.config.interrupt_rms_threshold,
        ai_interrupt_threshold=self.config.ai_interrupt_threshold,
        noise_gate_threshold=self.config.noise_gate_threshold,
        hang_frames=self.config.hang_frames,
        streak_trigger=self.config.vad_streak_trigger,
        pre_buffer_max_frames=self.config.pre_buffer_max_frames,
    )
    vad = VoiceActivityDetector(vad_config)

    # Share a single PyAudio instance across mic and speaker
    pa: Any = None
    if PYAUDIO_AVAILABLE and pyaudio is not None:
        try:
            pa = pyaudio.PyAudio()
        except Exception as pa_err:
            print(f"⚠️  [PyAudio Init Warning]: {pa_err}")

    mic_stream = MicrophoneStream(
        pa=pa,
        device_index=in_dev,
        capture_rate=self.config.mic_capture_rate,
        target_rate=self.config.gemini_input_rate,
    )

    player = AudioPlayer(
        pa=pa,
        device_index=out_dev,
        sample_rate=self.config.speaker_sample_rate,
    )

    media_player = MediaAudioPlayer(media_dir=self.config.media_directory)

    ws_url = GeminiLiveProtocol.get_ws_url(
        self.config.api_key,
        base_url=self.config.ws_base_url or "wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/google.ai.generativelanguage.v1beta.GenerativeService.BidiGenerateContent",
    )

    is_reconnect = False

    try:
        while not self._shutdown_event.is_set():
            try:
                print(f"🔗 Connecting to Gemini Live ({self.config.model})...")
                async with websockets.connect(
                    ws_url,
                    open_timeout=self.config.open_timeout,
                    close_timeout=self.config.close_timeout,
                    ping_interval=self.config.ping_interval,
                    max_size=None,
                ) as gemini_ws:
                    # Build dynamic system instruction (base prompt + user memory + tool rules)
                    sys_instruction = await self.build_effective_system_instruction(session_id=session_id)

                    # Send handshake setup message
                    tools_schema = self.tools.to_gemini_tools_payload()
                    setup_payload = GeminiLiveProtocol.build_setup_message(
                        model=self.config.model,
                        system_instruction=sys_instruction,
                        voice_name=self.config.voice,
                        tools_declarations=tools_schema,
                        is_reconnect=is_reconnect,
                    )
                    await gemini_ws.send(json.dumps(setup_payload))

                    # Await setup confirmation
                    raw_setup = await asyncio.wait_for(gemini_ws.recv(), timeout=15.0)
                    setup_str = raw_setup.decode("utf-8") if isinstance(raw_setup, (bytes, bytearray)) else str(raw_setup)
                    setup_data = json.loads(setup_str)
                    if "setupComplete" in setup_data:
                        print("✅ [Gemini Live Connected & Ready!]")
                    else:
                        print(f"⚠️  [Unexpected Setup Response]: {setup_str[:200]}")

                    # Drain any mic frames buffered during connection
                    while not mic_stream.queue.empty():
                        try:
                            mic_stream.queue.get_nowait()
                        except Exception:
                            break

                    # Proactive greeting: trigger so the assistant speaks immediately on startup
                    if not is_reconnect and self.config.greeting_message:
                        greet_payload = {
                            "clientContent": {
                                "turns": [{"role": "user", "parts": [{"text": self.config.greeting_message}]}],
                                "turnComplete": True,
                            }
                        }
                        await gemini_ws.send(json.dumps(greet_payload))
                        print("🎙️ [Greeting Triggered] — Assistant is introducing itself.")

                    # Session state
                    ai_is_speaking = False
                    tool_is_executing = False
                    interrupted_at = 0.0
                    user_has_spoken = not is_reconnect
                    session_turn = 0
                    user_speaking_logged = False

                    # ── Task A: Mic -> Gemini ──────────────────────────────
                    async def mic_to_gemini() -> None:
                        nonlocal ai_is_speaking, interrupted_at, user_has_spoken, user_speaking_logged
                        while not self._shutdown_event.is_set():
                            pcm = mic_stream.get_chunk(block=False)
                            if pcm is None:
                                await asyncio.sleep(0.005)
                                continue

                            if tool_is_executing:
                                continue

                            rms = compute_rms(pcm)

                            # Check barge-in on media audio file
                            if media_player.is_playing():
                                if vad.check_barge_in(pcm, self.config.interrupt_rms_threshold):
                                    print(f"\n⚡ [Interruption detected (RMS {int(rms)}) -> Stopping audio file]")
                                    media_player.stop()
                                    if self.on_interrupted:
                                        self.on_interrupted()
                                continue

                            # Check barge-in on AI speech
                            if ai_is_speaking or player.is_playing():
                                if vad.check_barge_in(pcm, self.config.ai_interrupt_threshold):
                                    print(f"\n⚡ [AI Interrupted (RMS {int(rms)}) -> Clearing speaker]")
                                    player.clear()
                                    media_player.stop()
                                    ai_is_speaking = False
                                    interrupted_at = time.time()
                                    user_has_spoken = True
                                    if self.on_interrupted:
                                        self.on_interrupted()
                                else:
                                    continue

                            # Noise gate and speech streaming
                            should_stream, frames = vad.process_chunk(pcm)
                            if should_stream:
                                if not user_speaking_logged and vad.gate_open:
                                    print(f"\n🎤 [Voice detected: RMS {int(rms)}]", flush=True)
                                    user_speaking_logged = True
                                user_has_spoken = True
                                for frame in frames:
                                    try:
                                        payload = GeminiLiveProtocol.encode_audio_chunk(frame)
                                        await gemini_ws.send(payload)
                                    except Exception:
                                        break
                            else:
                                user_speaking_logged = False

                    # ── Task B: Gemini -> Speaker + Tools ──────────────────
                    async def gemini_to_speaker() -> None:
                        nonlocal ai_is_speaking, tool_is_executing, interrupted_at, session_turn
                        ai_text_parts: list[str] = []
                        pending_audio_url: str | None = None

                        async for raw_msg in gemini_ws:
                            if self._shutdown_event.is_set():
                                break

                            msg_str = raw_msg.decode("utf-8") if isinstance(raw_msg, (bytes, bytearray)) else str(raw_msg)
                            parsed = GeminiLiveProtocol.parse_message(msg_str)
                            if parsed.error:
                                print(f"⚠️  [Gemini Error]: {parsed.error}")
                                continue

                            if parsed.interrupted:
                                player.clear()
                                ai_is_speaking = False
                                interrupted_at = time.time()
                                ai_text_parts.clear()
                                continue

                            # Handle tool calls
                            if parsed.tool_calls:
                                tool_is_executing = True
                                try:
                                    ctx = ToolExecutionContext(
                                        session_id=session_id,
                                        current_turn=session_turn,
                                    )
                                    fn_responses: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
                                    for tc in parsed.tool_calls:
                                        fn_name = tc.get("name", "")
                                        fn_args = tc.get("args", {})
                                        call_id = tc.get("id", "")

                                        tool_res = await self.tools.dispatch(fn_name, fn_args, ctx)
                                        if tool_res.queued_audio_url:
                                            pending_audio_url = tool_res.queued_audio_url

                                        fn_responses.append({
                                            "response": {
                                                "name": fn_name,
                                                "content": tool_res.to_gemini_response_content(),
                                            },
                                            "id": call_id,
                                        })
                                        if self.on_tool_executed:
                                            self.on_tool_executed(fn_name, fn_args, tool_res)

                                    if fn_responses:
                                        tool_payload = GeminiLiveProtocol.encode_tool_responses(fn_responses)
                                        await gemini_ws.send(tool_payload)
                                finally:
                                    tool_is_executing = False

                            # Process audio output
                            if parsed.audio_pcm_chunks:
                                if interrupted_at > 0.0 and (time.time() - interrupted_at) < 0.8:
                                    continue
                                if is_reconnect and not user_has_spoken:
                                    continue

                                ai_is_speaking = True
                                for chunk in parsed.audio_pcm_chunks:
                                    player.feed(chunk)

                            if parsed.text_parts:
                                ai_text_parts.extend(parsed.text_parts)

                            if parsed.turn_complete:
                                ai_is_speaking = False
                                interrupted_at = 0.0
                                full_text = "".join(ai_text_parts).strip()
                                ai_text_parts.clear()
                                session_turn += 1

                                # Notify turn complete immediately
                                if self.on_turn_complete and full_text:
                                    self.on_turn_complete(full_text)

                                # Record turn in memory and schedule entity extraction in background
                                if self.memory and full_text:
                                    await self.memory.add_message(
                                        session_id, role="assistant", content=full_text
                                    )
                                    if self.entity_extractor:
                                        asyncio.create_task(
                                            self.entity_extractor.extract_and_update(
                                                session_id, self.memory
                                            )
                                        )

                                # Only wait for speaker if an external pre-recorded audio file is queued
                                if pending_audio_url:
                                    while player.is_playing() and not self._shutdown_event.is_set():
                                        await asyncio.sleep(0.04)
                                    media_player.play(pending_audio_url)
                                    pending_audio_url = None

                                if self.farewell_detector.is_farewell(full_text):
                                    print("👋 [Session concluded by farewell]")
                                    self.stop()
                                    break

                    # Run both tasks concurrently
                    t_mic = asyncio.create_task(mic_to_gemini())
                    t_spk = asyncio.create_task(gemini_to_speaker())
                    done, pending = await asyncio.wait(
                        [t_mic, t_spk], return_when=asyncio.FIRST_COMPLETED
                    )
                    for task in pending:
                        task.cancel()
                        try:
                            await task
                        except (asyncio.CancelledError, Exception):
                            pass

                    for task in done:
                        err = task.exception()
                        if err:
                            raise err

            except (asyncio.CancelledError, KeyboardInterrupt):
                self._shutdown_event.set()
                break
            except Exception as exc:
                if self._shutdown_event.is_set():
                    break
                print(f"⚠️  [Session connection error]: {exc}")
                print(f"   Reconnecting in {self.config.reconnect_delay_seconds}s...")
                is_reconnect = True
                await asyncio.sleep(self.config.reconnect_delay_seconds)

    finally:
        mic_stream.close()
        player.close()
        media_player.close()
        if pa is not None:
            try:
                pa.terminate()
            except Exception:
                pass
        print("🛑 [Voice Agent Shutdown Complete]")

class AudioDeviceManager:
    """
    Cross-platform manager for querying, matching, and configuring
    independent input and output audio hardware.
    """

    @classmethod
    def list_devices(cls) -> list[AudioDeviceInfo]:
        """Returns all audio devices discovered on the host system."""
        if not PYAUDIO_AVAILABLE or pyaudio is None:
            return []

        pa = pyaudio.PyAudio()
        devices: list[AudioDeviceInfo] = []
        try:
            count = pa.get_device_count()
            for i in range(count):
                try:
                    info = pa.get_device_info_by_index(i)
                    host_api_idx = int(info.get("hostApi", 0))
                    host_api_info = pa.get_host_api_info_by_index(host_api_idx)
                    api_name = host_api_info.get("name", "Unknown") if host_api_info else "Unknown"

                    devices.append(
                        AudioDeviceInfo(
                            index=i,
                            name=str(info.get("name", f"Device {i}")),
                            max_input_channels=int(info.get("maxInputChannels", 0)),
                            max_output_channels=int(info.get("maxOutputChannels", 0)),
                            default_sample_rate=float(info.get("defaultSampleRate", 16000.0)),
                            host_api=str(api_name),
                        )
                    )
                except Exception:
                    continue
        finally:
            pa.terminate()

        return devices

    @classmethod
    def find_device_index(
        cls,
        spec: int | str | None,
        is_input: bool = True,
    ) -> int | None:
        """
        Resolves an audio device specification (integer index or fuzzy name string)
        to an actual PortAudio device index.

        Supports regex and substring matching (e.g., 'USB', 'bcm2835', 'AirPods').
        Returns None to use the system default if spec is None or device not found.
        """
        if spec is None:
            return None

        # Direct integer index
        if isinstance(spec, int):
            return spec

        spec_str = str(spec).strip()
        if not spec_str:
            return None

        # Check if spec is an integer formatted as string
        if spec_str.isdigit():
            return int(spec_str)

        all_devices = cls.list_devices()
        candidates = [d for d in all_devices if (d.is_input if is_input else d.is_output)]

        # 1. Exact case-insensitive match
        for dev in candidates:
            if dev.name.lower() == spec_str.lower():
                return dev.index

        # 2. Substring match
        for dev in candidates:
            if spec_str.lower() in dev.name.lower():
                return dev.index

        # 3. Regex match
        try:
            pattern = re.compile(spec_str, re.IGNORECASE)
            for dev in candidates:
                if pattern.search(dev.name):
                    return dev.index
        except re.error:
            pass

        return None

    @classmethod
    def find_best_input_device(cls, pa: Any, preferred_index: int | None = None) -> int | None:
        """
        Finds the most suitable working audio input device index (USB mic).
        Falls back to any input-capable device if the default is not marked.
        """
        count = pa.get_device_count()
        if count == 0:
            return None

        if preferred_index is not None:
            try:
                info = pa.get_device_info_by_index(preferred_index)
                if int(info.get("maxInputChannels", 0)) > 0:
                    return preferred_index
            except Exception:
                pass

        # 1. Try system default
        try:
            default_in = pa.get_default_input_device_info()
            if int(default_in.get("maxInputChannels", 0)) > 0:
                return int(default_in["index"])
        except Exception:
            pass

        # 2. Search for USB / mic device
        usb_candidate = None
        first_input = None
        for i in range(count):
            try:
                info = pa.get_device_info_by_index(i)
                if int(info.get("maxInputChannels", 0)) > 0:
                    if first_input is None:
                        first_input = i
                    name_lower = str(info.get("name", "")).lower()
                    if "usb" in name_lower or "mic" in name_lower:
                        usb_candidate = i
                        break
            except Exception:
                continue

        return usb_candidate if usb_candidate is not None else first_input

    @classmethod
    def find_best_output_device(cls, pa: Any, preferred_index: int | None = None) -> int | None:
        """
        Finds the most suitable working audio output device index (Speaker / Bluetooth).
        """
        count = pa.get_device_count()
        if count == 0:
            return None

        if preferred_index is not None:
            try:
                info = pa.get_device_info_by_index(preferred_index)
                if int(info.get("maxOutputChannels", 0)) > 0:
                    return preferred_index
            except Exception:
                pass

        # 1. Try system default
        try:
            default_out = pa.get_default_output_device_info()
            if int(default_out.get("maxOutputChannels", 0)) > 0:
                return int(default_out["index"])
        except Exception:
            pass

        # 2. Search for preferred output devices (Pulse, bluez, default, headphone, speaker)
        first_output = None
        preferred_candidate = None
        for i in range(count):
            try:
                info = pa.get_device_info_by_index(i)
                if int(info.get("maxOutputChannels", 0)) > 0:
                    if first_output is None:
                        first_output = i
                    name_lower = str(info.get("name", "")).lower()
                    if any(k in name_lower for k in ("pulse", "default", "bluez", "headphone", "speaker", "usb", "bcm2835", "jack", "audio", "alsa")):
                        preferred_candidate = i
                        break
            except Exception:
                continue

        return preferred_candidate if preferred_candidate is not None else first_output

    @classmethod
    def print_diagnostics(cls) -> None:
        """Prints a user-friendly terminal table of available audio devices."""
        devices = cls.list_devices()
        print("\n" + "=" * 65)
        print("🔊 [VOICE FRAMEWORK - AUDIO HARDWARE DIAGNOSTICS]")
        print("=" * 65)

        inputs = [d for d in devices if d.is_input]
        outputs = [d for d in devices if d.is_output]

        print("\n🎤 Microphone / Input Devices:")
        if not inputs:
            print("  (None detected)")
        for d in inputs:
            print(f"  • [{d.index}] {d.name} ({int(d.default_sample_rate)}Hz, {d.host_api})")

        print("\n🔈 Speaker / Output Devices:")
        if not outputs:
            print("  (None detected)")
        for d in outputs:
            print(f"  • [{d.index}] {d.name} ({int(d.default_sample_rate)}Hz, {d.host_api})")
        print("=" * 65 + "\n")

def find_best_output_device(cls, pa: Any, preferred_index: int | None = None) -> int | None:
    """
    Finds the most suitable working audio output device index (Speaker / Bluetooth).

    count = pa.get_device_count()
    if count == 0:
        return None

    if preferred_index is not None:
        try:
            info = pa.get_device_info_by_index(preferred_index)
            if int(info.get("maxOutputChannels", 0)) > 0:
                return preferred_index
        except Exception:
            pass

        default_out = pa.get_default_output_device_info()
        if int(default_out.get("maxOutputChannels", 0)) > 0:
            return int(default_out["index"])
    except Exception:
        pass

    # 2. Search for preferred output devices (Pulse, bluez, default, headphone, speaker)
    first_output = None
    preferred_candidate = None
    for i in range(count):
        try:
            info = pa.get_device_info_by_index(i)
            if int(info.get("maxOutputChannels", 0)) > 0:
                if first_output is None:
                    first_output = i
                name_lower = str(info.get("name", "")).lower()
                if any(k in name_lower for k in ("pulse", "default", "bluez", "headphone", "speaker", "usb", "bcm2835", "jack", "audio", "alsa")):

                    break
        except Exception:

@classmethod
def find_device_index(
    cls,
    spec: int | str | None,
    is_input: bool = True,
) -> int | None:
    """
    Resolves an audio device specification (integer index or fuzzy name string)
    to an actual PortAudio device index.

    Supports regex and substring matching (e.g., 'USB', 'bcm2835', 'AirPods').
    Returns None to use the system default if spec is None or device not found.
    """
    if spec is None:
        return None

    # Direct integer index
    if isinstance(spec, int):
        return spec

    spec_str = str(spec).strip()
    if not spec_str:
        return None

    # Check if spec is an integer formatted as string
    if spec_str.isdigit():
        return int(spec_str)

    all_devices = cls.list_devices()
    candidates = [d for d in all_devices if (d.is_input if is_input else d.is_output)]

    # 1. Exact case-insensitive match
    for dev in candidates:
        if dev.name.lower() == spec_str.lower():
            return dev.index

    # 2. Substring match
    for dev in candidates:
        if spec_str.lower() in dev.name.lower():
            return dev.index

    # 3. Regex match
    try:
        pattern = re.compile(spec_str, re.IGNORECASE)
        for dev in candidates:
            if pattern.search(dev.name):
                return dev.index
    except re.error:
        pass

    return None

class MicrophoneStream:
    """
    Continuous microphone input capture stream.
    Opens PyAudio stream on the chosen hardware device and delivers
    standardized 16kHz mono PCM chunks to an async or threaded queue.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        pa: Any | None = None,
        device_index: int | None = None,
        capture_rate: int = 16000,
        target_rate: int = 16000,
        channels: int = 1,
        frames_per_buffer: int = 512,
        max_queue_size: int = 300,
    ) -> None:
        self.device_index = device_index
        self.capture_rate = capture_rate
        self.target_rate = target_rate
        self.channels = channels
        self.frames_per_buffer = frames_per_buffer
        self.queue: queue.Queue[bytes | None] = queue.Queue(maxsize=max_queue_size)
        self.shutdown_event = threading.Event()
        self._pa_owner: bool = False
        self._stream: Any = None
        self._ratecv_state: Any = None

        if not PYAUDIO_AVAILABLE or pyaudio is None:
            return

        if pa is None:
            self._pa = pyaudio.PyAudio()
            self._pa_owner = True
        else:
            self._pa = pa

        # Hardware rate negotiation: test capture_rate, fallback to 48000 or 16000 if device complains
        actual_rate = self._negotiate_sample_rate()
        self.capture_rate = actual_rate

        try:
            self._stream = self._pa.open(
                format=pyaudio.paInt16,
                channels=channels,
                rate=actual_rate,
                input=True,
                input_device_index=device_index,
                frames_per_buffer=frames_per_buffer,
                stream_callback=self._audio_callback,
            )
            self._stream.start_stream()
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"⚠️  [MicrophoneStream] Failed to open microphone input ({actual_rate}Hz, dev={device_index}): {exc}")

    def _negotiate_sample_rate(self) -> int:
        """Finds a compatible hardware capture rate supported by PortAudio."""
        candidate_rates = [16000, self.capture_rate, 48000, 44100]
        for rate in candidate_rates:
            try:
                supported = self._pa.is_format_supported(
                    rate=rate,
                    input_device=self.device_index,
                    input_channels=self.channels,
                    input_format=getattr(pyaudio, "paInt16", 2),
                )
                if supported:
                    return rate
            except Exception:
                continue
        return self.capture_rate

    def _audio_callback(self, in_data: Any, frame_count: int, time_info: Any, status: Any) -> tuple[None, int]:
        if self.shutdown_event.is_set():
            return None, getattr(pyaudio, "paComplete", 2)

        if not in_data:
            return None, getattr(pyaudio, "paContinue", 0)

        # Convert to 16kHz if needed
        if self.capture_rate != self.target_rate and audioop is not None:
            try:
                resampled, self._ratecv_state = audioop.ratecv(
                    in_data,
                    2,  # 2 bytes per sample (int16)
                    self.channels,
                    self.capture_rate,
                    self.target_rate,
                    self._ratecv_state,
                )
                chunk_to_queue = resampled
            except Exception:
                chunk_to_queue = in_data
        else:
            chunk_to_queue = in_data

        try:
            self.queue.put_nowait(chunk_to_queue)
        except queue.Full:
            pass  # Drop oldest or skip if consumer blocked

        return None, getattr(pyaudio, "paContinue", 0)

    def get_chunk(self, block: bool = True, timeout: float | None = None) -> bytes | None:
        """Retrieves the next 16kHz PCM chunk."""
        try:
            return self.queue.get(block=block, timeout=timeout)
        except queue.Empty:
            return None

    def close(self) -> None:
        """Closes the audio input stream."""
        self.shutdown_event.set()
        if self._stream is not None:
            try:
                self._stream.stop_stream()
                self._stream.close()
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._stream = None

        if self._pa_owner and self._pa is not None:
            try:
                self._pa.terminate()
            except Exception:
                pass

class MediaAudioPlayer:
    """
    Manages physical audio file playback (e.g. farmer experiences, music, prompts)
    with non-blocking execution and event hooks.
    """

    def __init__(self, media_dir: str = "audio_experiences") -> None:
        self.media_dir = media_dir
        self._playing_event = threading.Event()
        self._initialized = False

    def _init_pygame(self) -> None:
        if self._initialized:
            return
        if PYGAME_AVAILABLE and pygame is not None:
            try:
                if not pygame.mixer.get_init():
                    pygame.mixer.init()
                self._initialized = True
            except Exception as exc:
                print(f"⚠️  [MediaAudioPlayer] pygame mixer init warning: {exc}")

    def play(
        self,
        audio_url_or_path: str,
        on_complete: Callable[[], None] | None = None,
    ) -> bool:
        """
        Plays an MP3 or WAV file asynchronously on a background thread.
        Returns True if playback started successfully.
        """
        if not PYGAME_AVAILABLE or pygame is None:
            print("⚠️  [MediaAudioPlayer] pygame unavailable — skipping audio file playback")
            return False

        self._init_pygame()

        # Extract filename if URL format (e.g., /api/experiences/audio/valsad.mp3)
        clean_path = audio_url_or_path.replace("\\", "/")
        filename = clean_path.split("/")[-1]

        # Check both direct path and media_dir path
        filepath = clean_path if os.path.isfile(clean_path) else os.path.join(self.media_dir, filename)

        if not os.path.isfile(filepath):
            print(f"⚠️  [MediaAudioPlayer] File not found: {filepath}")
            return False

        try:
            self._init_pygame()
            pygame.mixer.music.load(filepath)
            pygame.mixer.music.play()
            self._playing_event.set()
            print(f"▶️  [MediaAudioPlayer] Playing audio file: {filename}")

            def _monitor() -> None:
                while pygame is not None and pygame.mixer.music.get_busy():
                    time.sleep(0.15)
                if self._playing_event.is_set():
                    self._playing_event.clear()
                    if on_complete:
                        try:
                            on_complete()
                        except Exception as cb_err:
                            print(f"⚠️  [MediaAudioPlayer] Completion callback error: {cb_err}")

            threading.Thread(target=_monitor, daemon=True).start()
            return True
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"⚠️  [MediaAudioPlayer] Playback error: {exc}")
            self._playing_event.clear()
            return False

    def is_playing(self) -> bool:
        """Returns True if a media file is actively playing."""
        return self._playing_event.is_set()

    def stop(self) -> None:
        """Immediately stops media audio playback."""
        if not PYGAME_AVAILABLE or pygame is None:
            return
        self._playing_event.clear()
        try:
            if pygame.mixer.get_init() and pygame.mixer.music.get_busy():
                pygame.mixer.music.stop()
                print("⏹️  [MediaAudioPlayer] Audio playback stopped.")
        except Exception:
            pass

    def close(self) -> None:
        """Closes the audio subsystem."""
        self.stop()
        if PYGAME_AVAILABLE and pygame is not None:
            try:
                pygame.mixer.quit()
            except Exception:
                pass

    Abstract Base Class for managing dialogue history and persistent user profiles.

        """Returns ordered messages for the given session."""

        self,
        session_id: str,
        profile_data: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Merges new profile details into the user's saved state."""

    async def build_context_prompt(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        header: str = "[KNOWN USER CONTEXT]",
    ) -> str:
        """
        Constructs a clean, human-readable context block from known profile details
        for dynamic injection into voice system prompts.
        """
        profile = await self.get_profile(session_id)
        if not profile:
            return ""

        lines = [header]
        for key, val in profile.items():
            if val is not None and val != "":
                # Format key from snake_case to Title Case
                formatted_key = key.replace("_", " ").title()
                if isinstance(val, list):
                    val_str = ", ".join(str(item) for item in val)
                else:
                    val_str = str(val)
                lines.append(f"• {formatted_key}: {val_str}")

        if len(lines) == 1:
            return ""

        lines.append("(Use these known details naturally; do not repeatedly re-ask the user for them)")
        return "\n".join(lines)

            if isinstance(val, list):
                val_str = ", ".join(str(item) for item in val)
            else:
                val_str = str(val)
            lines.append(f"• {formatted_key}: {val_str}")

    if len(lines) == 1:
        return ""

    lines.append("(Use these known details naturally; do not repeatedly re-ask the user for them)")
    return "\n".join(lines)

class InMemoryMemoryStore(BaseMemoryStore):
    """
    Thread-safe in-memory store for sessions, messages, and profile attributes.
    """

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._sessions: dict[str, ConversationSession] = {}
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def get_or_create_session(self, session_id: str) -> ConversationSession:
        async with self._lock:
            if session_id not in self._sessions:
                self._sessions[session_id] = ConversationSession(session_id=session_id)
            return self._sessions[session_id]

    async def add_message(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        role: str,
        content: str,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> ChatMessage:
        session = await self.get_or_create_session(session_id)
        async with self._lock:
            return session.add_message(role=role, content=content, metadata=metadata)

    async def get_messages(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        limit: int | None = None,
    ) -> list[ChatMessage]:
        session = await self.get_or_create_session(session_id)
        async with self._lock:
            if limit is not None and limit > 0:
                return list(session.messages[-limit:])
            return list(session.messages)

    async def update_profile(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        profile_data: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        session = await self.get_or_create_session(session_id)
        async with self._lock:
            session.update_profile(profile_data)
            return dict(session.profile)

    async def get_profile(self, session_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        session = await self.get_or_create_session(session_id)
        async with self._lock:
            return dict(session.profile)

    async def clear_session(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            self._sessions.pop(session_id, None)

class SQLiteMemoryStore(BaseMemoryStore):
    """
    Asynchronous SQLite memory store for session history and user profiles.
    """

    def __init__(self, db_path: str = "agent_memory.db") -> None:
        self.db_path = db_path
        self._init_db_sync()

    def _init_db_sync(self) -> None:
        """Initializes database tables if they do not exist."""
        with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            # 1. Sessions table
            cursor.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS voice_sessions (
                    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    created_at REAL,
                    updated_at REAL
                )
            """)
            # 2. Messages table
            cursor.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS voice_messages (
                    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
                    session_id TEXT,
                    role TEXT,
                    content TEXT,
                    timestamp REAL,
                    metadata_json TEXT,
                    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES voice_sessions (session_id)
                )
            """)
            # 3. Profiles table
            cursor.execute("""
                CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS voice_profiles (
                    session_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
                    profile_json TEXT,
                    updated_at REAL,
                    FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES voice_sessions (session_id)
                )
            """)
            conn.commit()

    async def get_or_create_session(self, session_id: str) -> ConversationSession:
        def _get() -> ConversationSession:
            now = time.time()
            with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                cursor.execute("SELECT created_at, updated_at FROM voice_sessions WHERE session_id = ?", (session_id,))
                row = cursor.fetchone()
                if row:
                    created_at, updated_at = row[0], row[1]
                else:
                    cursor.execute(
                        "INSERT INTO voice_sessions (session_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                        (session_id, now, now)
                    )
                    conn.commit()
                    created_at, updated_at = now, now

                # Fetch messages
                cursor.execute(
                    "SELECT role, content, timestamp, metadata_json FROM voice_messages WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY id ASC",
                    (session_id,)
                )
                msgs = [
                    ChatMessage(
                        role=r[0],
                        content=r[1],
                        timestamp=r[2],
                        metadata=json.loads(r[3]) if r[3] else {}
                    )
                    for r in cursor.fetchall()
                ]

                # Fetch profile
                cursor.execute("SELECT profile_json FROM voice_profiles WHERE session_id = ?", (session_id,))
                p_row = cursor.fetchone()
                profile = json.loads(p_row[0]) if p_row and p_row[0] else {}

                return ConversationSession(
                    session_id=session_id,
                    messages=msgs,
                    profile=profile,
                    created_at=created_at,
                    updated_at=updated_at,
                )

        return await asyncio.to_thread(_get)

    async def add_message(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        role: str,
        content: str,
        metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> ChatMessage:
        def _add() -> ChatMessage:
            now = time.time()
            meta_json = json.dumps(metadata or {})
            with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                # Ensure session exists
                cursor.execute(
                    "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO voice_sessions (session_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                    (session_id, now, now)
                )
                cursor.execute(
                    "INSERT INTO voice_messages (session_id, role, content, timestamp, metadata_json) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    (session_id, role, content, now, meta_json)
                )
                cursor.execute("UPDATE voice_sessions SET updated_at = ? WHERE session_id = ?", (now, session_id))
                conn.commit()
            return ChatMessage(role=role, content=content, timestamp=now, metadata=metadata or {})

        return await asyncio.to_thread(_add)

    async def get_messages(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        limit: int | None = None,
    ) -> list[ChatMessage]:
        def _get() -> list[ChatMessage]:
            with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                query = "SELECT role, content, timestamp, metadata_json FROM voice_messages WHERE session_id = ? ORDER BY id ASC"
                cursor.execute(query, (session_id,))
                rows = cursor.fetchall()
                if limit is not None and limit > 0:
                    rows = rows[-limit:]
                return [
                    ChatMessage(
                        role=r[0],
                        content=r[1],
                        timestamp=r[2],
                        metadata=json.loads(r[3]) if r[3] else {}
                    )
                    for r in rows
                ]

        return await asyncio.to_thread(_get)

    async def update_profile(
        self,
        session_id: str,
        profile_data: dict[str, Any],
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        def _update() -> dict[str, Any]:
            now = time.time()
            with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                # Ensure session exists
                cursor.execute(
                    "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO voice_sessions (session_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                    (session_id, now, now)
                )
                cursor.execute("SELECT profile_json FROM voice_profiles WHERE session_id = ?", (session_id,))
                row = cursor.fetchone()
                existing = json.loads(row[0]) if row and row[0] else {}

                # Merge non-null data
                for k, v in profile_data.items():
                    if v is not None and v != "":
                        existing[k] = v

                cursor.execute(
                    "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO voice_profiles (session_id, profile_json, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                    (session_id, json.dumps(existing), now)
                )
                cursor.execute("UPDATE voice_sessions SET updated_at = ? WHERE session_id = ?", (now, session_id))
                conn.commit()
                return existing

        return await asyncio.to_thread(_update)

    async def get_profile(self, session_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        def _get() -> dict[str, Any]:
            with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                cursor.execute("SELECT profile_json FROM voice_profiles WHERE session_id = ?", (session_id,))
                row = cursor.fetchone()
                return json.loads(row[0]) if row and row[0] else {}

        return await asyncio.to_thread(_get)

    async def clear_session(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        def _clear() -> None:
            with sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) as conn:
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                cursor.execute("DELETE FROM voice_messages WHERE session_id = ?", (session_id,))
                cursor.execute("DELETE FROM voice_profiles WHERE session_id = ?", (session_id,))
                cursor.execute("DELETE FROM voice_sessions WHERE session_id = ?", (session_id,))
                conn.commit()

        await asyncio.to_thread(_clear)

@dataclass(slots=True)
class WhatsAppConfig:
    """
    Configuration options for WhatsApp messaging in the Voice AI Framework.
    Natively supports:
      1. Official Meta / Facebook WhatsApp Business Cloud API (token, phone_number_id)
      2. Custom REST gateways / webhook relays (service_url, api_key)
    """
    token: str = ""  # Official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API Access Token
    phone_number_id: str = ""  # Official Meta Phone Number ID (sender ID)
    business_account_id: str = ""  # Meta WABA / Business Account ID (optional)
    api_version: str = "v21.0"  # Meta Graph API version

    # Generic or custom gateway parameters
    api_key: str = ""  # API key for generic/custom gateway (or alias for token)
    service_url: str = ""  # Custom service URL (auto-generated if phone_number_id is provided)
    provider: str = "auto"  # "auto" | "meta" | "generic" | "webhook"

    # Messaging defaults
    default_template: str = ""
    default_language: str = "en"
    phone_prefix: str = "91"  # Default country calling code
    timeout: float = 15.0

    # Custom auth header overrides
    auth_header_name: str | None = None  # e.g., "Authorization" or "API-KEY"
    auth_header_prefix: str | None = None  # e.g., "Bearer "

    # Voice AI safety & guardrails
    require_two_turn_confirmation: bool = True

    # Localized / customized conversational messages
    invalid_phone_message: str | None = None
    confirmation_prompt_message: str | None = None
    success_message: str | None = None
    prompt_instruction: str | None = None


    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        # Standardize token and api_key aliases
        if not self.token and self.api_key:
            object.__setattr__(self, "token", self.api_key)
        elif not self.api_key and self.token:
            object.__setattr__(self, "api_key", self.token)

        # Resolve provider
        if self.provider == "auto":
            if self.phone_number_id:
                object.__setattr__(self, "provider", "meta")
            elif self.service_url:
                object.__setattr__(self, "provider", "generic")
            else:
                object.__setattr__(self, "provider", "generic")

        # Auto-construct Meta Graph API endpoint URL if phone_number_id is provided
        if self.provider == "meta" and self.phone_number_id:
            constructed_url = f"https://graph.facebook.com/{self.api_version}/{self.phone_number_id}/messages"
            object.__setattr__(self, "service_url", constructed_url)

class WhatsAppClient:
    """
    Asynchronous and synchronous transport client for WhatsApp notification gateways.
    Seamlessly dispatches to Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API or custom HTTP REST gateways.
    """

    def __init__(self, config: WhatsAppConfig | None = None) -> None:
        self.config = config or WhatsAppConfig.from_env()

    def normalize_phone(self, raw: str) -> str:
        """
        Validates and standardizes a phone number using the configured country prefix.
        Filters out dummy, invalid, or repeating phone sequences.
        """
        if not raw:
            return ""
        digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", raw)
        prefix = self.config.phone_prefix

        # If already starts with prefix (e.g., 919876543210 -> 9876543210)
        if prefix and digits.startswith(prefix) and len(digits) == 10 + len(prefix):
            digits = digits[len(prefix):]
        elif digits.startswith("0") and len(digits) == 11:
            digits = digits[1:]

        # Must be standard 10 mobile digits
        if len(digits) != 10:
            return ""
        # Filter trivial / dummy numbers
        if len(set(digits)) <= 2:
            return ""
        if digits in ("1234567890", "0123456789", "9876543210", "0000000000"):
            return ""
        # Valid starting digits
        if digits[0] not in "56789":
            return ""

        return (prefix + digits) if prefix else digits

    def _get_headers(self) -> dict[str, str]:
        headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        token = self.config.token or self.config.api_key
        if not token:
            return headers

        if self.config.provider == "meta":
            h_name = self.config.auth_header_name or "Authorization"
            h_prefix = self.config.auth_header_prefix if self.config.auth_header_prefix is not None else "Bearer "
            headers[h_name] = f"{h_prefix}{token}".strip()
        else:
            h_name = self.config.auth_header_name or "API-KEY"
            h_prefix = self.config.auth_header_prefix or ""
            headers[h_name] = f"{h_prefix}{token}".strip()
        return headers

    def _build_payload(
        self,
        to: str | list[str],
        body_params: list[str] | None = None,
        button_params: list[str] | None = None,
        template_name: str | None = None,
        language: str | None = None,
        raw_text: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        recipients = [to] if isinstance(to, str) else list(to)
        normalized = [self.normalize_phone(r) for r in recipients if self.normalize_phone(r)]
        if not normalized:
            raise ValueError("No valid recipient phone numbers provided.")

        tpl = template_name or self.config.default_template
        lang = language or self.config.default_language

        if self.config.provider == "meta":
            # Meta Graph Cloud API payload structure
            if tpl:
                params_obj = [{"type": "text", "text": p} for p in (body_params or [])]
                return {
                    "messaging_product": "whatsapp",
                    "recipient_type": "individual",
                    "to": normalized[0],
                    "type": "template",
                    "template": {
                        "name": tpl,
                        "language": {"code": lang},
                        "components": [{"type": "body", "parameters": params_obj}],
                    },
                }
            else:
                return {
                    "messaging_product": "whatsapp",
                    "recipient_type": "individual",
                    "to": normalized[0],
                    "type": "text",
                    "text": {
                        "preview_url": False,
                        "body": raw_text or "",
                    },
                }

        # Generic REST gateway payload
        payload: dict[str, Any] = {
            "api_key": self.config.token or self.config.api_key,
            "to": normalized,
            "type": "template" if tpl else "text",
            "template_name": tpl,
            "language": lang,
            "body_params": body_params or [],
        }
        if raw_text:
            payload["message"] = raw_text
        if button_params:
            payload["button_params"] = button_params
        return payload

    async def send_template_async(
        self,
        to: str | list[str],
        body_params: list[str] | None = None,
        button_params: list[str] | None = None,
        template_name: str | None = None,
        language: str | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Sends a WhatsApp template message asynchronously via HTTP POST."""
        if not HTTPX_AVAILABLE or httpx is None:
            raise RuntimeError("httpx is required for WhatsApp messaging. Run: pip install httpx")
        service_url = self.config.service_url
        if not service_url:
            raise ValueError(
                "WhatsApp service_url or phone_number_id is not configured. "
                "For Meta Cloud API, provide 'phone_number_id' and 'token'. "
                "For custom gateways, provide 'service_url' and 'api_key'."
            )

        payload = self._build_payload(
            to=to,
            body_params=body_params,
            button_params=button_params,
            template_name=template_name,
            language=language,
        )
        headers = self._get_headers()

        try:
            async with httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=self.config.timeout) as client:
                resp = await client.post(service_url, json=payload, headers=headers)
                resp.raise_for_status()
                try:
                    return resp.json()
                except Exception:
                    return {"status": "success", "raw": resp.text}
        except httpx.HTTPStatusError as exc:
            err_text = exc.response.text

def normalize_phone(self, raw: str) -> str:
    """
    Validates and standardizes a phone number using the configured country prefix.
    Filters out dummy, invalid, or repeating phone sequences.
    """
    if not raw:
        return ""
    digits = re.sub(r"\D", "", raw)
    prefix = self.config.phone_prefix

    # If already starts with prefix (e.g., 919876543210 -> 9876543210)
    if prefix and digits.startswith(prefix) and len(digits) == 10 + len(prefix):
        digits = digits[len(prefix):]
    elif digits.startswith("0") and len(digits) == 11:
        digits = digits[1:]

    # Must be standard 10 mobile digits
    if len(digits) != 10:
        return ""
    # Filter trivial / dummy numbers
    if len(set(digits)) <= 2:
        return ""
    if digits in ("1234567890", "0123456789", "9876543210", "0000000000"):
        return ""
    # Valid starting digits
    if digits[0] not in "56789":
        return ""

    return (prefix + digits) if prefix else digits

class TwoTurnConfirmationNotificationTool(BaseTool):
    """
    Guarded notification tool requiring explicit multi-turn confirmation before dispatch.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        description: str,
        parameters_schema: Dict[str, Any],
        sender_func: Callable[[str, str], Coroutine[Any, Any, Dict[str, Any]]],
        normalize_phone_func: Callable[[str], str] = default_normalize_phone,
        format_text_func: Optional[Callable[[str], str]] = None,
        phone_param: str = "phone_number",
        text_param: str = "answer_text",
        invalid_phone_message_builder: Optional[Callable[[str], str]] = None,
        confirmation_needed_message_builder: Optional[Callable[[str, str], str]] = None,
        success_message_builder: Optional[Callable[[str], str]] = None,
        pending_confirmations_dict: Optional[Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]] = None,
        turn_counter_dict: Optional[Dict[str, int]] = None,
        prompt_instruction: Optional[str] = None,
    ):
        self._name = name
        self._description = description
        self._parameters_schema = parameters_schema
        self.sender_func = sender_func
        self.normalize_phone_func = normalize_phone_func
        self.format_text_func = format_text_func or (lambda t: t)
        self.phone_param = phone_param
        self.text_param = text_param
        self.invalid_phone_message_builder = invalid_phone_message_builder
        self.confirmation_needed_message_builder = confirmation_needed_message_builder
        self.success_message_builder = success_message_builder
        self._prompt_instruction = prompt_instruction or (
            f"• NOTIFICATION & MESSAGING PROTOCOL (`{self._name}`):\n"
            f"  1. When the user asks to send an answer or provides their phone number, DO NOT call `{self._name}` in that turn.\n"
            f"  2. First say verbally: 'Your phone number is [phone_number], correct?' and stop speaking.\n"
            f"  3. Only in the subsequent turn, after the user confirms (e.g. 'yes/correct'), call `{self._name}`.\n"
            "  4. Never invent or use dummy phone numbers like '0000000000'."
        )

        # In-memory tracking of pending confirmations: session_id -> confirmation dict
        self._pending_confirmations = pending_confirmations_dict if pending_confirmations_dict is not None else {}
        self.turn_counter_dict = turn_counter_dict

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return self._name

    @property
    def description(self) -> str:
        return self._description

    @property
    def parameters_schema(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        return self._parameters_schema

    @property
    def prompt_instruction(self) -> Optional[str]:
        return self._prompt_instruction

    @property
    def pending_confirmations(self) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
        return self._pending_confirmations


    def get_pending(self, session_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
        return self._pending_confirmations.get(session_id)

    def clear_pending(self, session_id: str) -> None:
        self._pending_confirmations.pop(session_id, None)

    async def execute(self, args: Dict[str, Any], context: ToolExecutionContext) -> ToolResult:
        phone_raw = args.get(self.phone_param, "")
        text_raw = args.get(self.text_param, "")
        formatted_text = self.format_text_func(text_raw)

        phone = self.normalize_phone_func(phone_raw)
        if not phone:
            print(f"📲 [{self.name}] ❌ Blocked invalid/dummy phone: {phone_raw!r}")
            if self.invalid_phone_message_builder:
                msg = self.invalid_phone_message_builder(phone_raw)
            else:
                msg = (
                    f"Invalid or missing phone number: '{phone_raw}'. "
                    "A valid 10-digit mobile number was not found. "
                    "Please ask the user for their 10-digit phone number, "
                    "and verbally confirm it with them before sending. "
                    "Never use fictional or dummy numbers."
                )
            return ToolResult(status="error", message=msg)

        curr_turn = context.current_turn
        if self.turn_counter_dict is not None and context.session_id in self.turn_counter_dict:
            curr_turn = self.turn_counter_dict[context.session_id]

        pending = self._pending_confirmations.get(context.session_id)

        # Strict 2-turn confirmation gate:
        # Message is ONLY dispatched if confirmation was previously requested
        # in an earlier turn (< curr_turn) and the phone matches.
        is_confirmed = False
        if pending and pending.get("phone") == phone:
            if pending.get("asked_at_turn", -1) < curr_turn:
                is_confirmed = True

        if not is_confirmed:
            self._pending_confirmations[context.session_id] = {
                "phone": phone,
                "answer_text": formatted_text,
                "asked_at_turn": curr_turn,
                "timestamp": time.time(),
            }
            print(f"📲 [{self.name} Gate] ⏳ Confirmation requested for {phone} (Turn {curr_turn}). Holding send...")
            if self.confirmation_needed_message_builder:
                conf_msg = self.confirmation_needed_message_builder(phone, phone_raw)
            else:
                conf_msg = (
                    f"Phone number {phone} recorded, but notification is not sent yet. "
                    f"Please say to the user: 'Your phone number is {phone_raw}, right?' and stop speaking. "
                    "Wait for the user to confirm in the next turn before calling this tool again."
                )
            return ToolResult(status="confirmation_required", message=conf_msg)

        # Confirmed! Proceed to send
        self._pending_confirmations.pop(context.session_id, None)
        try:
            send_res = await self.sender_func(phone, formatted_text)
            if send_res.get("status") == "error":
                err_msg = f"Notification send failed: {send_res.get('error', 'Unknown error')}"
                print(f"📲 [{self.name}] Send failed to {phone}: {send_res}")
                return ToolResult(status="error", message=err_msg)
            else:
                if self.success_message_builder:
                    succ_msg = self.success_message_builder(phone)
                else:
                    succ_msg = f"Notification successfully sent to {phone}."
                print(f"📲 [{self.name}] Sent to {phone}: {formatted_text[:60]}...")
                return ToolResult(status="sent", message=succ_msg)

        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"📲 [{self.name}] Exception while sending: {exc}")
            return ToolResult(status="error", message=f"Notification error: {exc}")

class RAGRetriever:
    """
    Modular RAG retrieval engine.
    Connects any embedding model with primary and fallback vector stores.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        embedding_model: BaseEmbeddingModel,
        vector_store: BaseVectorStore,
        fallback_store: BaseVectorStore | None = None,
        default_limit: int = 3,
        default_score_threshold: float = 0.45,
        query_normalizer: Callable[[str], str] | None = None,
    ) -> None:
        self.embedding_model = embedding_model
        self.vector_store = vector_store
        self.fallback_store = fallback_store
        self.default_limit = default_limit
        self.default_score_threshold = default_score_threshold
        self.query_normalizer = query_normalizer

    async def retrieve(
        self,
        query: str,
        limit: int | None = None,
        score_threshold: float | None = None,
        filter_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> list[DocumentChunk]:
        """
        Retrieves relevant document chunks for a natural language voice query.
        Falls back to fallback_store if primary store is unreachable or yields no matches.
        """
        clean_query = (query or "").strip()
        if not clean_query:
            return []

        if self.query_normalizer is not None:
            try:
                clean_query = self.query_normalizer(clean_query)
            except Exception as norm_err:
                print(f"⚠️  [RAGRetriever] Query normalizer error: {norm_err}")

        lim = limit if limit is not None else self.default_limit
        thresh = score_threshold if score_threshold is not None else self.default_score_threshold

        # 1. Generate query embedding vector
        query_vector: list[float] = []
        try:
            query_vector = await self.embedding_model.embed_query(clean_query)
        except Exception as emb_err:
            print(f"⚠️  [RAGRetriever] Embedding generation error: {emb_err}")

        # 2. Search primary vector store
        matches: list[DocumentChunk] = []
        if query_vector:
            try:
                matches = await self.vector_store.search(
                    query_vector=query_vector,
                    limit=lim,
                    score_threshold=thresh,
                    filter_metadata=filter_metadata,
                )
            except Exception as store_err:
                print(f"⚠️  [RAGRetriever] Primary store error ({self.vector_store.name}): {store_err}")

        # 3. Fallback to secondary store if primary returned no matches
        if not matches and self.fallback_store is not None:
            print(f"ℹ️  [RAGRetriever] Querying fallback store: {self.fallback_store.name}")
            try:
                if query_vector:
                    matches = await self.fallback_store.search(
                        query_vector=query_vector,
                        limit=lim,
                        score_threshold=thresh,
                        filter_metadata=filter_metadata,
                    )
                # If still no matches and fallback is InMemoryVectorStore, try keyword search
                if not matches and isinstance(self.fallback_store, InMemoryVectorStore):
                    matches = self.fallback_store.search_keyword(clean_query, limit=lim)
            except Exception as fb_err:
                print(f"⚠️  [RAGRetriever] Fallback store error ({self.fallback_store.name}): {fb_err}")

        return matches

    def build_context_text(
        self,
        matches: list[DocumentChunk],
        header: str | None = None,
        footer: str | None = None,
    ) -> str:
        """Formats retrieved chunks into a standardized context block for LLM prompts."""
        if not matches:
            return ""
        blocks = [f"- [{m.title}]: {m.text}" for m in matches if m.text]
        content = "\n\n".join(blocks)
        parts = []
        if header:
            parts.append(header)
        parts.append(content)
        if footer:
            parts.append(footer)
        return "\n\n".join(parts)

    async def __call__(
        self,
        query: str,
        limit: int | None = None,
        score_threshold: float | None = None,
        filter_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        **kwargs: Any,
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Callable interface directly compatible with KnowledgeBaseTool's retriever_func.
        Returns list of dicts.
        """
        chunks = await self.retrieve(
            query=query,
            limit=limit,
            score_threshold=score_threshold,
            filter_metadata=filter_metadata,
        )
        return [c.to_dict() for c in chunks]

class BaseVectorStore(ABC):
    """
    Abstract Base Class for vector storage and semantic retrieval backends.
    """

    @property
    @abstractmethod
    def name(self) -> str:
        """Name of the vector database backend (e.g. In-Memory, Qdrant, Pinecone)."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def search(
        self,
        query_vector: list[float],
        limit: int = 3,
        score_threshold: float = 0.5,
        filter_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> list[DocumentChunk]:
        """
        Searches the vector store using dense query vectors.
        Returns matched DocumentChunks ranked by descending similarity score.
        """
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def upsert(
        self,
        chunks: list[DocumentChunk],
        vectors: list[list[float]],
    ) -> None:
        """Stores or updates document chunks with their dense vector embeddings."""
        pass

    @abstractmethod
    async def is_available(self) -> bool:
        """Returns True if the backend is reachable and ready to serve queries."""
        pass

    async def get_stats(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Returns collection/index statistics (point counts, dimensions, status)."""
        available = await self.is_available()
        return {
            "status": "online" if available else "offline",
            "name": self.name,
            "points_count": 0,
            "vectors_count": 0,
        }

    async def delete_points(self, point_ids: list[str]) -> int:
        """Deletes specific point IDs from the vector store."""
        return 0

    async def delete_by_filter(self, filter_metadata: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """Deletes documents matching the specified metadata filter."""
        return False

    async def init_collection(self) -> bool:
        """Ensures the collection or index exists, creating it if required."""
        return True

class InMemoryVectorStore(BaseVectorStore):
    """
    In-memory vector store with optional JSON persistence.
    """

    def __init__(self, name: str = "In-Memory Store") -> None:
        self._name = name
        self._chunks: list[DocumentChunk] = []
        self._vectors: list[list[float]] = []

    @property
    def name(self) -> str:
        return self._name

    async def is_available(self) -> bool:
        return True

    async def get_stats(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """Returns statistics of in-memory store."""
        return {
            "status": "online",
            "name": self.name,
            "points_count": len(self._chunks),
            "vectors_count": len(self._vectors),
        }

    async def delete_points(self, point_ids: list[str]) -> int:
        """Deletes points by ID."""
        id_set = set(point_ids)
        new_chunks = []
        new_vectors = []
        deleted = 0
        for c, v in zip(self._chunks, self._vectors):
            if c.id in id_set:
                deleted += 1
            else:
                new_chunks.append(c)
                new_vectors.append(v)
        self._chunks = new_chunks
        self._vectors = new_vectors
        return deleted

    async def delete_by_filter(self, filter_metadata: dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
        """Deletes chunks matching filter."""
        new_chunks = []
        new_vectors = []
        for c, v in zip(self._chunks, self._vectors):
            match = True
            for k, val in filter_metadata.items():
                if c.metadata.get(k) != val:
                    match = False
                    break
            if not match:
                new_chunks.append(c)
                new_vectors.append(v)
        self._chunks = new_chunks
        self._vectors = new_vectors
        return True

    async def upsert(
        self,
        chunks: list[DocumentChunk],
        vectors: list[list[float]],
    ) -> None:
        """Stores chunks with their corresponding vectors."""
        for c, v in zip(chunks, vectors):
            c.vector_store = self.name
            self._chunks.append(c)
            self._vectors.append(v)

    async def search(
        self,
        query_vector: list[float],
        limit: int = 3,
        score_threshold: float = 0.5,
        filter_metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> list[DocumentChunk]:
        """Performs cosine similarity search against stored vectors."""
        if not self._chunks:
            return []

        # If query vector is empty or all zeros, return empty (or let keyword search handle)
        if not query_vector or all(v == 0.0 for v in query_vector):
            return []

        results: list[tuple[float, DocumentChunk]] = []

        for chunk, vec in zip(self._chunks, self._vectors):
            # Check metadata filter
            if filter_metadata:
                match = True
                for k, v in filter_metadata.items():
                    if chunk.metadata.get(k) != v:
                        match = False
                        break
                if not match:
                    continue

            score = cosine_similarity(query_vector, vec)
            if score >= score_threshold:
                match_chunk = DocumentChunk(
                    id=chunk.id,
                    title=chunk.title,
                    text=chunk.text,
                    score=round(score, 4),
                    metadata=chunk.metadata,
                    audio_url=chunk.audio_url,
                    vector_store=self.name,
                )
                results.append((score, match_chunk))

        # Sort descending by score
        results.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
        return [chunk for _, chunk in results[:limit]]

    def search_keyword(
        self,
        query: str,
        limit: int = 3,
    ) -> list[DocumentChunk]:
        """
        Fast token-based lexical search fallback when embeddings are unavailable.
        """
        if not query or not self._chunks:
            return []

        words = [w.lower() for w in query.strip().split() if len(w) > 1]
        if not words:
            return []

        scored: list[tuple[int, DocumentChunk]] = []
        for chunk in self._chunks:
            haystack = f"{chunk.title} {chunk.text}".lower()
            match_count = sum(1 for w in words if w in haystack)
            if match_count > 0:
                scored.append((match_count, chunk))

        scored.sort(key=lambda x: x[0], reverse=True)
        return [
            DocumentChunk(
                id=c.id,
                title=c.title,
                text=c.text,
                score=round(score / max(len(words), 1), 2),
                metadata=c.metadata,
                audio_url=c.audio_url,
                vector_store=f"{self.name} (Keyword)",
            )
            for score, c in scored[:limit]
        ]

    @classmethod
    def from_json_file(cls, filepath: str) -> InMemoryVectorStore:
        """
        Loads document chunks and vectors from a structured JSON file.
        Accepts list of dictionaries with {title, text, metadata, audio_url, vector?}.
        """
        store = cls(name=f"JSON Store ({os.path.basename(filepath)})")
        if not os.path.isfile(filepath):
            return store

        try:
            with open(filepath, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = json.load(f)

            items = data if isinstance(data, list) else data.get("records", [])
            for item in items:
                chunk = DocumentChunk(
                    title=item.get("title", ""),
                    text=item.get("text", "") or item.get("content", ""),
                    metadata=item.get("metadata", {}),
                    audio_url=item.get("audio_url"),
                    vector_store=store.name,
                )
                vec = item.get("vector") or item.get("embedding") or []
                store._chunks.append(chunk)
                store._vectors.append(vec if isinstance(vec, list) else [])
        except Exception as exc:
            print(f"⚠️  [InMemoryVectorStore] Error loading {filepath}: {exc}")

        return store
